# Netherlands

[global-law](../) / Netherlands

18 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 17 case law): see [REPOSITORIES.md](REPOSITORIES.md).

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 96% (estimate, medium confidence, 91.8–100.0%) | 0% | 100% |

Strong coverage: netherlands-law holds every regulation in the Basiswettenbestand (35,466, of which about 16,000 still have text and about 19,500 are repealed, README only), including all the essential codes with in-force history from 2002, current to 2026-11-02, and both spot checks pass; all 17 case-law repositories are current to 2026-11-10. Weak points: no provincial or municipal law, no law of Aruba, Curaçao or Sint Maarten, and several of the repository's own metadata claims (version counts, '292 with history', 'not built') are wrong.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
